articles.headline: One More Day: Austin Hill Eyes Another Daytona Opener
articles.dek: The NASCAR on JRN Xfinity Series season opens tomorrow at Daytona with Austin Hill chasing his fifth season-opening win in six years.
articles.body:
The wait is nearly over for the NASCAR on JRN Xfinity Series as the field prepares for the United Rentals 300 at Daytona International Speedway. Coverage begins at 5 PM ET on JRN on February 14th, 2026, marking the official start of a new simulated racing campaign.

All eyes point directly at Austin Hill as the green flag approaches. Hill enters the season opener as the driver to beat after dominating Speedweeks over recent years, capturing four of the last five season-opening victories at the historic 2.5-mile superspeedway. His recent history at Daytona establishes him as the undisputed favorite to control the draft and defend his ongoing restrictor-plate dynasty.

With zero races in the books, the standings remain a blank slate, leaving every team on equal footing before tomorrow afternoon. The draft packs, single-file freight trains, and late-race shuffling will dictate who survives the chaotic opening laps and positions themselves for a shot at the trophy.

Teams face their final technical inspections this morning before final practices wrap up. The drivers know the superspeedway drafting dynamics leave zero room for error, and the race on JRN will set the competitive baseline for the entire 2026 season.
